history_rule: Last 10 completed R games of each team strictly before target scheduled start; >=10 required. No target or later completion admitted. Preserve explicit completion provenance/uncertainty; exclude ordering that cannot be established.
market_control: Highest two-sided proportional no-vig probability; exactly equal is TIE_ABSTAIN.
recommendation: HOME if home prior10 win count > away; AWAY if less; TIE_ABSTAIN if equal.
selection: Unique full game identity; no result-based filtering.
